name: example-seo-mcp
description: An MCP server exposing SEO analysis tools: page audits, AI-search readiness checks, and structured-data generation.
author: Your Organisation

tools.name: audit_page
tools.description: Fetch a URL and return a JSON report of on-page SEO signals: title, meta description, H1–H6 structure, canonical, and internal link count.

tools.name: check_ai_readiness
tools.description: Return a JSON report on AI-search discoverability: robots.txt access for retrieval bots (OAI-SearchBot, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot), presence of llms.txt, and structured data validity.

tools.name: generate_jsonld
tools.description: Given a page URL and a schema type (Article, Product, FAQ, HowTo, Organization), return suggested JSON-LD markup.

tools.name: validate_robots
tools.description: Parse a robots.txt URL and report which AI crawlers are allowed, blocked, or unmentioned.
